# haruhime.moe

> Source for https://www.haruhime.moe, the home page for haruhime's osu! tools for players, mappers and tournament hosts (packs and bb, an osu! BBCode editor, are live; pools, a mappool builder, is live in beta; sheets is coming soon). The site also has a thanks list, the brand kit, the libraries the tools are built from (the nine @haruhimemoe packages with live npm and GitHub numbers, and each README as a docs page), a showcase of every @haruhimemoe/ui component, contact details, a disclaimer, terms and a privacy policy. It is a static Next.js 16 site built from @haruhimemoe/ui, run with Bun. MIT license. The live site serves its own llms.txt at https://www.haruhime.moe/llms.txt; that one is the canonical guide to the pages and tools. This file covers the repository.

## Site

- [llms.txt on the live site](https://www.haruhime.moe/llms.txt): the canonical guide to the site's pages and tools, built from the same data as the pages
- [llms-full.txt on the live site](https://www.haruhime.moe/llms-full.txt): the brand page, every library's docs page, each repo's newest changelog entries and every legal page, each in full
- [haruhime.moe](https://www.haruhime.moe/): the live site
- [Libraries](https://www.haruhime.moe/libraries): the nine @haruhimemoe packages with version, downloads, stars and latest release, each linking its docs page
- [Changelog](https://www.haruhime.moe/changelog): every haruhimemoe repo's releases, newest first, filterable to apps, packages or one repo, each with its own page at `/changelog/<repo>`
- [UI showcase](https://www.haruhime.moe/ui): every @haruhimemoe/ui component rendered in its states

## Docs

- [Pages](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/haruhime.moe#pages): every route and what it shows
- [Run it locally](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/haruhime.moe#run-it-locally): requirements, install, dev server and production build
- [Where the content lives](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/haruhime.moe#where-the-content-lives): which file holds the thanks list, the tools, the links, each page's copy and the repo banners
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/haruhime.moe/blob/main/AGENTS.md): conventions, invariants (every route static) and file layout for AI coding agents

## Source

- [src/constants/tools.ts](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/haruhime.moe/blob/main/src/constants/tools.ts): the tools, their taglines, hues and links
- [src/content/thanks.ts](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/haruhime.moe/blob/main/src/content/thanks.ts): the thanks list
- [src/constants/site.ts](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/haruhime.moe/blob/main/src/constants/site.ts): site identity and PAGES, every page's label, search title, description and last-updated day (read by page metadata, the sitemap, /llms.txt and the footer)
- [src/constants/seo.ts](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/haruhime.moe/blob/main/src/constants/seo.ts): SEO_SITE, the site as @haruhimemoe/next-kit/seo sees it (metadata, robots, sitemap, JSON-LD)
- [src/utils/llms-txt.ts](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/haruhime.moe/blob/main/src/utils/llms-txt.ts): builds the live /llms.txt with next-kit's contentLlmsTxt
- [src/constants/libraries.ts](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/haruhime.moe/blob/main/src/constants/libraries.ts): the nine packages /libraries lists, each one's description and links
- [src/lib/libraries/](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/haruhime.moe/tree/main/src/lib/libraries): the npm and GitHub lookups and the README fetch behind /libraries, cached for a day, null on failure
- [src/utils/readme.ts](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/haruhime.moe/blob/main/src/utils/readme.ts): cleans a README for the docs page (banner and title dropped, relative links to GitHub)
- [src/constants/content.ts](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/haruhime.moe/blob/main/src/constants/content.ts): the content registry, every legal page in content/legal/ with its title, description and date
- [src/constants/brand.ts](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/haruhime.moe/blob/main/src/constants/brand.ts): the brand color swatches, and REPO_BANNERS, the list of every haruhimemoe repo's README banner
- [src/components/showcase/](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/haruhime.moe/tree/main/src/components/showcase): the /ui demos, one file per group
- [scripts/repo-banners.ts](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/haruhime.moe/blob/main/scripts/repo-banners.ts): draws those banners into public/brand/repos (`bun run repo-banners`)

## Elsewhere

- [@haruhimemoe/ui](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/ui): the React components and theme the site is built from
- [@haruhimemoe/brand](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/brand): generates the logos, icons, link preview and the repo README banners
- [packs.haruhime.moe](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/packs.haruhime.moe): source for packs, the first tool
- [pools.haruhime.moe](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/pools.haruhime.moe): source for pools, the mappool builder (a mod-lens map search, co-editors, download through packs), with past tournament pools for reference and the content-rules check (beta)
- [haruhimemoe on GitHub](https://github.com/haruhimemoe): the other tools and packages

## Optional

- [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/haruhime.moe/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): what changed on the site
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/haruhime.moe/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): setup, checks, changelog lines and regenerating the brand files and repo banners
- [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/haruhime.moe/blob/main/SECURITY.md): how to report a vulnerability (GitHub private vulnerability reporting first, or email)
